messages.subject: Error when Loading Rattle file
parts:
I am still having an error when loading Rattle files. The files seem
to be large when this happens(3,000 to 100,000 rows), and when I load
it I get the error:

Error in if (file.exists(uri2file(crs$filename)))
theWidget("data_filechooserbutton")$setUri(crs$filename) else crs
$filename <- basename(crs$filename) :
argument is of length zero

When the rattle file loads the data does not show up and the file is
unusable. If I have run any models, they don't show up either.

Is there a workaround to this? Is this something that can be fixed?
I want to use Rattle for work, but this error makes it very difficult.

Thanks

Thanks for the bug report.
